operations.text: 0.3.3 homes the execution guards a consumer wrote during its first plans under the new cycle: no claim without an opened file or the word UNVERIFIED; a consumer grep of every changed definition before dispatch; one defect line per acceptance criterion before the first paid pass; a plan-recorded bar, pin, threshold or cap moves only through escalation trigger 1; a product dialog names the field lost and its definition; environment preflight and a unit baseline by test name before VERIFY; the operator's own live run closes a ticket whose outcome is visible in the running product; the revision stop rule counts carried OPEN rows; every new test red under a named fault then green, narrowings grepped; the Writer's three stop conditions in every dispatch; the planner brief's CLOSING GREPS block and trim-by-citing; the research brief's two new sections; the plan skill's input question and runnability pre-pass. The per-ticket byte cap is now plan.ticketByteCap (this update wrote 6144 into your config). Delete the local copies of these rules on your operator's word - the CHANGELOG's Retires line names them.
